name: anki
description: Review your AnkiWeb decks above the Claude Code prompt while Claude works. Syncs straight with AnkiWeb through Anki's own Rust core; no Anki desktop or AnkiConnect needed.

syncServer.title: Sync server (optional)
syncServer.description: Leave blank to sync with AnkiWeb (sync.ankiweb.net), the default. To use your own Anki sync server instead, enter its URL here.
